description: Use when you need South Korea's monthly trade for a product by HS code (e.g. 8542 chips, 870323 cars, 2710 petroleum). Data: Korea Customs Service, finalized monthly. Input: hs (2-10 digit prefix), optional month (YYYYMM, default latest), limit (1-100), sort (exports, imports, balance, total). Output: JSON totals (exports FOB, imports CIF, balance in USD, kg) with YoY % and 10-digit HSK lines with English HS descriptions and YoY. Example: ?hs=8542&month=202608 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

hs.description: HS code prefix, 2-10 digits (e.g. 8542 integrated circuits, 870323 passenger cars)

name: kr_trade_hs
title: Korea monthly exports/imports by HS code (Korea Customs), English HS descriptions, YoY
